notes.title: Winter-een-mas in Teleporter: World of Gamers!
notes.notes:
Let's celebrate the ultimate holiday of gamers,[i][b] Winter-een-mas[/b][/i], in Teleporter tonight! 
We will [b]gather in the Teleporter Tavern as gamers[/b] to play board games, watch game streams and compete on arcade together with our beloved gamer and geek community! 

Is this gonna be your very first time celebrating a holiday in VR? You will get used to celebrating many more events in World of Gamers from now on!

[b]Come join us tonight at [u]8 pm CET[/u] in Teleporter: WoG! [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37364528/a8442ac5fd99ac94475713e389c8d409017e0753.jpg[/img]

notes.title: New Year in Teleporter: WoG!
notes.notes:
We are celebrating new year in WoG! 

Come join us at 9pm CET, [b]building a snowman[/b] in the [b][i]Central Hub[/i][/b] and [b]decorating a lovely tree[/b] in the [b][i]Tavern[/i][/b] together! A board game night after that? Sounds amazing!

We all are waiting for the new year's spirit and the celebrations for so long. 
Let's have a great time together tonight! 

Join us at [u][b]9.00 pm CET in Teleporter![/b][/u]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37364528/b436f4f3350db4e8662c3202a3efe67fbdd1fbf2.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Another Board Game Available in the Tavern!
notes.notes:
[b]New Game Alert!!![/b]

Great news! We are releasing another board game today at 8pm CET! 
In an hour, come join us in the tavern to play Betrayal, oh sorry, [i][b]Betroyal[/b][/i]!

notes.notes:
We will celebrate the newest Darkmoon Faire update of HS in the tavern, and open 100 new packages to find the latest legendaries! Come join us tonight in the Drunk Dragon Tavern!

notes.notes:

notes.title: SpaceX Crew Dragon Launch!
notes.notes:
Hey folks! We're gonna watch SpaceX Crew Dragon Launch starting with 9pm CET (3 pm ET) in the tavern! After the launch, we will go on with the board game event of the day! Come join us on this amazing day!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37364528/42c38024baaf36b8d50e594a6c0ccda7045a8c44.png[/img]

notes.title: Another LoTR Night in Teleporter!
notes.notes:
We started to watch the series with Ian McKellen's birthday and today the series goes on with [b]The Two Towers[/b]! Come join us watching the second movie together in Teleporter! It starts at 9 pm CET.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37364528/b4d7b8b6099595f50d0d9f7f7c22f101b38b4a46.png[/img]

notes.title: The Arcade Tournament!
notes.notes:
Happy birthday, Pac-Man! Teleporter Arcade Night is here! We are playing remade arcade games and try to beat each others' high scores! You like retro games? Come join us now and beat others and take your place on the leader board!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37364528/38597ab8bb76ec5acccfed4375212009d8b9a905.png[/img]

notes.title: WoW Sub Give-Away during the Warcraft Movie Night!
notes.notes:
In this week's community event, our players are gonna stream [b]the Warcraft movie[/b] and we will give away two [b]one-month subscriptions for World of Warcraft![/b]

Two players (one from the EU and one from the US) will be receiving subscriptions during the event night.

Come join us this Thursday! Meet our amazing community and take your chance of a[b] free sub for WoW![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37364528/839e45b0184cc65576c0e762206dc639aea917c1.png[/img]

notes.title: Teleporter: WoG 101
notes.notes:
Hey folks! The community is getting together today to help the new players to get most of Teleporter. Don't be shy! Join us, meet amazing folks in VR, and learn all the how-to-dos from the experienced players!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37364528/df716781cd26bfe1482e5faf106306838582d55c.png[/img]

notes.title: Teleporter: World of Gamers (Alpha) Release Event
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37364528/bae68f3f0ddbd83eb0cadd0b7d4548dea106fb5c.png[/img]
We are excited to finally announce that Teleporter: World of Gamers alpha version is now available to download. We are gonna meet today in the tavern at 9 pm CET (10 pm CEST) to celebrate together with the community. Grab your VR headset and join this amazing night!
